itinerary.title: Phnom Penh to Hanoi & Welcome Night

events.activity: Flight from Phnom Penh to Hanoi (Noi Bai International Airport)
Private bus transfer & Hotel Check-in in Hanoi
Optional evening walk & explore Hanoi Night Life
Buffet breakfast at the hotel
Transfer to Vietnam Exhibition Center by private coach
Visit Cafe Show Vietnam Expo (Tea, Coffee, Machinery & Ingredients)
Lunch break at the exhibition center
Focused B2B Matchmaking & brand negotiations with suppliers
Return to hotel and refresh
Hanoi Old Quarter cultural walk, dining & famous attraction sites

itinerary.title: Smart City Expo, Factory Visit & Journey to Halong Bay

events.activity: Breakfast at the hotel
Coach departure to Vietnam Exhibition Center
Explore Smart City Expo (IoT, Smart Lighting, Infrastructure & Tech)
Lunch break at Exhibition Center
On-site visit to wholesale coffee/tea roasting factory and showroom
Scenic highway transfer to picturesque Halong Bay
Hotel check-in & explore Halong Bay Night Market and coastal promenade

itinerary.title: UNESCO Halong Bay Cruise & Return to Phnom Penh

events.activity: Breakfast at hotel and express check-out
Transfer to Halong Bay International Tourist Harbour
Deluxe Cruise along Halong Bay UNESCO World Heritage Site with fresh seafood lunch
Private expressway transfer directly to Hanoi Noi Bai Airport
Check-in and international customs clearance
Flight back to Phnom Penh International Airport

faqs.answer: Cambodian passport holders can enter Vietnam visa-free for up to 30 days. Our team also handles arrival paperwork and customs facilitation.
faqs.question: Do I need a visa for Vietnam?

faqs.answer: No. You reserve with just your name and phone number. Our coordinator calls you within 15 minutes, and you pay only after details are verified.
faqs.question: Do I have to pay today?

faqs.answer: Yes. We issue corporate billing and official tax invoices — just request it during your confirmation call.
faqs.question: Can my company get an official invoice?

faqs.answer: The package includes premium twin/double sharing. Single private rooms are available with a small supplement upon request.
